description: This source file defines the 'I18NLangString' entity class used in the internationalization module of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_i18n_lang_string' and includes properties for language string attributes such as id, unitId, group, value, note, version, and translations, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: I18NLangString
classes.description: Entity class representing a language string used for internationalization, with attributes such as id, unitId, group, value, note, version, and translations, managed via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the language string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the language string.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit identifier associated with the language string.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit identifier for the language string.

methods.name: setGroup
methods.description: Associates an I18NGroup entity with this language string.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the text value of the language string.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the text value of the language string.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any supplementary note associated with the language string.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets a note for the language string.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for the language string.

methods.name: setVersion
methods.description: Sets the version string for the language string.
